target: SWE intern / new-grad roles (general software engineering, 2026–27 recruiting cycle)
seven_second_takeaway: UMD CS '28, AWS SDE intern now, Capital One SWE intern last summer, Amazon-client contract work, ML research. Strong brands; clean one-pager.

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Top-of-page AWS bullet is a vague one-liner; Capital One index bullet and several UMIACS/project bullets end without a result.
score_rationale.quantification: Good numbers on most roles, but 90%/93% survey stats lack sample size, and the 270K+ bold anchors scope, not outcome.
score_rationale.concision_readability: Every bullet is a dense two-liner; jargon (Claude sub-skills, AnyGrasp, rdtscp, Amazon Leo) slows a non-specialist reader.
score_rationale.credibility: Four concurrent 'Present' roles plus a full-time AWS internship in Redmond invites a 'how many hours per week?' question.

must_fix: AWS internship, the most recognizable line on the page, has one vague in-progress bullet ('Researching and implementing...'); make it say concretely what is being built, even if work-in-progress.

clarify: the Capital One search-index bullet ends at intent ('to minimize DB queries under access limits') with no stated outcome.
